stage: implementation details fixed before any market persistence static or neural fit

numeric_precision.scoring: float64 exact Gaussian and lognormal mixture formulae, no Monte Carlo price scoring

static_optimizer_budget.finite_valid_nonconverged_result: Retain the prescribed fixed-budget optimizer result with success, status, nfev, nit, fun and initial fun disclosed. This does not mean optimizer convergence. No alternative method or data-dependent extra budget.
static_optimizer_budget.invalid_result: Reject nonfinite parameters, scores or invalid probability/state paths; no replacement forecast.

implementation_smoke.source_identity: Original smoke receipt preserves the hashes actually executed. Later changes are input guards, output archive compactness and precision wording; no change to the training mathematics.
implementation_smoke.later_zero_gradient_interface_check: Implementer checked eight architectures: compact training f/rho equal full prediction exactly; zero additional optimizer steps and no market reads. This check is not called an independent audit.

private_artifacts.training: All 41 epoch logs, selected checkpoint, selected f/rho and indices/dates. Complete train densities can be reconstructed from checkpoint and prepared arrays; do not duplicate them or compute redundant training price metrics.
private_artifacts.validation_and_test: Full per-origin mixture weights, zero means, component standard deviations, f/rho, targets and all metrics.
private_artifacts.optimizer_states: Selected optimizer and final optimizer are separately labeled; final optimizer is not paired with selected model weights.

sharding: Three disjoint process shards, one Torch/BLAS thread each. Identical fixed per-job training budgets and per-panel data; no adaptive reassignment of market selection.
